data_definitions: asOfDay = dateInTimeZone(currentNow, meta.timezone) (service-core L142); all durations are whole calendar days via daysBetween(start, end) (L153-162), which returns null for non-YYYY-MM-DD input and clamps at 0, so every 'ordered' check compares ISO-day strings first. Limit: minute-level facts never enter a metric so the bootstrap ETag stays stable within a day.

custody (per vehicle): 'conflict' when movement.locationConfidence === 'conflicting' or movement.state === 'location_exception'; 'in_transit' when movement.currentLocation === 'In transit'; 'away' when a ledger row says currentLocation is a store ≠ homeStore (custodyBasis 'ledger') or there is no ledger and sourceReportedLocation (= publicStore, L1026) ≠ homeStore (custodyBasis 'source_reported'); 'on_lot' otherwise. 'visiting' is a store-perspective count (currentStore or sourceReportedLocation equals the card's store while homeStore differs). returnLeg 'return' when the row's movement_status is return_in_transit. Limit: source-reported custody is the website's store, not physical custody, and the basis word is always rendered.

daysAway = daysBetween(dateInTimeZone(new Date(movement.departedAt), tz), asOfDay) when custody is away or in_transit and departedAt exists; else null (daysAwayBasis 'unknown'). departedAt = movementDepartureAt(row, events) (L666-683): the earliest event after the last returned_home among direct_move_recorded, vehicle_departed, picked_up, in_transit, a destination-tagged customer_showing/sale_outcome_pending/sale_confirmed/not_sold (to_location_id === destination_store_id), or return_started from the destination; undefined while only requested/approved, for unknown/conflicting confidence, and while home. Only returned_home (workflowPatch L702-713) resets the clock. Limit: an approved-but-not-departed request has no days away.

unaccounted: first matching rule wins, N = thresholds.unaccountedAfterDays = 7 (single threshold): (1) location_conflict = custody conflict; (2) source_conflict = crmStore && crmStore !== publicStore; (3) no_app_record = custody away with custodyBasis source_reported; (4) stale_confirmation = custody away/in_transit and daysBetween(dateInTimeZone(new Date(lastConfirmedAt ?? row.requested_at), tz), asOfDay) >= 7. Vehicles on their home lot with no ledger are never unaccounted. Limit: the rule cannot see a unit that moved without any app record and is still listed at home.

returnOverdue (attributed to the home store) = the storeSummaries rule (L1386-1394): isActiveTransfer(row), return_required, return_due_at, new Date(return_due_at) < now, status not in {returned_home, closed} nor {sale_confirmed, delivery_confirmed}, movement_status not in {returned_home, closed}. receivedHomeAt = ISO day of the latest returned_home event when within recentReceiptDays (7) of asOfDay; return verification is derived client-side from returnLeg + receivedHomeAt. Limit: other stores' rows are only those visible to the viewer (transferVisible L1259), so counts are viewer-relative and labelled 'Moves as visible to you'.

holds (per store) = holdSignals[store].activeHoldVins (holdSignalSummaries L1683-1710: hold_vehicle_snapshots rows with crm_store_id === store and active_hold_count > 0); holdsPastExpected = holdSignals[store].pastExpected (same rows, dateIsBeforeReport(expected_date, reportDate)). Per-vehicle holdActive/holdPastExpected facts come from the same rows, never from hold.state or hold.label, so Inventory view=holds equals the card. Row chips render hold.label verbatim (states primary | multiple | none_observed | stale | unknown); none_observed is never counted as available and the not-held chip is exactly 'No current DealerMail hold found'. Limit: storeSummaries.currentHolds and meta.heldVinCount count rows including active_hold_count = 0 (importer database.mjs L407-421) and are never displayed on the Overview.

service dates (per vehicle): when serviceReadiness.readinessBasis === 'manager_updated', enteredAt = isoDay(row.service_entered_at) and completedAt = isoDay(row.completed_at) from the manager row only; when basis is ford_service_history_inspection or autocheck_post_intake_inspection, enteredAt = readinessEvidence.inServiceDate and completedAt = readinessEvidence.readyDate ?? inspectionDate; any other basis has no dates. arrivalDate = earliest(isoDay(serviceIntake.first_arrival_date), isoDay(vehicle.inventoryDate)) (intakeDay rule, service-readiness.mjs L36-46) with arrivalBasis intake | listing_date | unknown. serviceStatus = serviceWorkflowStatus(status) (needs_service | in_service | serviced). Limit: serviceReadinessView (L115-116) falls back to evidence dates even for a needs_service manager row, so the view's dates are never used blindly.

waitingDays (status needs_service only) = daysBetween(arrivalDate, asOfDay). Limit: intake dates exist only for vehicles whose new_arrival was observed after migration 0008; older units use the public listing date, which can lag physical receipt.

receiptToStartDays (status in_service or serviced only) = daysBetween(arrivalDate, enteredAt) when both exist and arrivalDate <= enteredAt as ISO strings; else null. Aggregated as a median with n per store and group.

inServiceDays: status in_service → daysBetween(enteredAt, asOfDay) ('currently in service', the median uses these only); status serviced → daysBetween(enteredAt, completedAt) when both exist and enteredAt <= completedAt; else null.

receiptToReadyDays (status serviced only) = daysBetween(arrivalDate, completedAt) when both exist and arrivalDate <= completedAt; else null. Limit: evidence-based Ready carries the source's dates (Ford/AutoCheck), not the store's.

sinceServiceUpdateDays = daysBetween(dateInTimeZone(new Date(row.updated_at), tz), asOfDay) when a manager row exists (updated_at is an ISO timestamp). dateOrderIssue = true when enteredAt < arrivalDate, completedAt < arrivalDate or completedAt < enteredAt as ISO-day strings (feeds the service_date_order exception).

service aggregates per store (serviceReadiness.store = serviceStore(): verified current location if a store else home store) and group: counts by status; counts by readinessBasis (manager_updated, ford_service_history_inspection, autocheck_post_intake_inspection, new_arrival, unconfirmed, legacy_review); medians with n for receiptToStartDays, inServiceDays (in_service only), receiptToReadyDays; agedWaiting14/agedWaiting30 = needs_service vehicles with waitingDays >= 14 / >= 30; arrivalBasis distribution. Invariant: readiness is evaluated on the full vehicle view before any list projection (M15 cuts fordOasis.serviceHistory bodies that fordServiceReadinessEvidence reads, L65-84).

agedBucket = 90 when daysListed >= 90, 60 when >= 60, only when vehicle.publicListing === 'listed' (the code, never a label); daysListed = daysBetween(publicRecord.inventory_date, reportDate) for public rows (L1000-1002). CRM-only rows use crmRecord.inventoryAgeNumber (CRM age), get agedBasis 'crm_age' and no bucket, so 'Listed 60+ days' counts listed vehicles only. Limit: listing age is not lot age.

records (per vehicle) = { autoCheck: autoCheckReport?.dataState === 'current', oasis: fordOasis?.dataState === 'current', sticker: windowSticker?.dataState === 'current', invoice: fordInvoice?.dataState === 'current', fordHistory: fordOasis?.serviceHistory?.historyCaptured === true }; recordsApplicable = 5 for Ford/Lincoln makes (/^(ford|linc|lincoln)$/i) else 3 (autoCheck, sticker, invoice); recordsCaptured = count of true among applicable; store 'Records incomplete' = vehicles with recordsCaptured < recordsApplicable. Limit: presence means a current capture exists, not that its content is complete.

dispositions (Slice B, per owner store): counts of the latest vehicle_disposition_events row per VIN by code keep | sold_pending | delivered | wholesale | transfer_out | none, grouped by dispositionOwnerStore(source) = source.homeAssignment?.home_store_id || (publicRecord?.store || crmRecord?.storeName), which is role-independent. Never inferred from a listing disappearing, a sale_confirmed/delivery_confirmed move event or the imported manager log.

exceptions (server list per store with vins ≤ 50): location_conflict, source_conflict, no_app_record, stale_confirmation (from unaccounted), return_overdue, hold_past_expected, identity_review (managerIdentityReviewRecord count), records_incomplete, service_date_order, and in Slice B listed_but_delivered (appDisposition delivered && publicListing === 'listed' && daysBetween(effectiveDate, asOfDay) >= 3) and delivered_move_no_disposition (visible transfer with delivery_status delivery_confirmed and no delivered disposition; managers only; a prompt, never an inference).
